_comment: Component package library for 2-resistor (2R) compact thermal models. r_jc / r_jb in K/W, sizes in mm (L x W x H). Entries WITH r_jc come from a cited standard. Entries with r_jc = null are geometry templates: theta values of commercial parts are die- and vendor-specific, so the component in the case file MUST provide r_jc (and ideally r_jb) from the device datasheet (JESD51 test methods).

packages.name: Ceramic DIP, die area > 14,400 mil^2
packages.standard: MIL-HDBK-217F Notice 2, section 5.11 (theta_JC default table, ceramic packages)
packages.notes: Default for reliability prediction when the manufacturer value is unknown. Column-to-die-area mapping read from the handbook table: verify against your copy.
